name: GET_BALANCE
description: Get the HBAR and token balances for a Hedera account. If no account ID is provided, returns the agent's own balance. This is a free query with no transaction fee.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Defaults to operator account if no accountId provided
implicitBehaviors.details: Uses agent.accountId for setAccountId() when input.accountId is not specified.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Token balances are extracted from balance.toJSON().tokens
implicitBehaviors.details: The query result includes a tokens map. Each entry is converted to { tokenId, balance, decimals } format.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: HBAR balance returned as human-readable string
implicitBehaviors.details: Uses balance.hbars.toString() which includes the ℏ unit symbol.

inputs.name: accountId
inputs.describe: The Hedera Account ID to check (e.g. 0.0.12345). Defaults to the agent's own account.

successData.name: accountId
successData.describe: The account ID that was queried

successData.name: hbarBalance
successData.describe: HBAR balance as a human-readable string

successData.name: tokens
successData.describe: Array of { tokenId, balance, decimals } for associated tokens

errorMap.details: The account ID does not exist on this network.
